findings.detail: Original lifecycle physical-H helper treated Mandel shear components as tensor shear, unlike model/source/reference. Correct decoding divides shears by sqrt2.

The test labeled a finite −200percent strain increment invalid although schema only requires finite strain and the endpoint backward-Euler relation can admit positive pressure for arbitrarily large finite unloading. Continuous positive-pressure differential path instead reaches zero at finite extension. Need distinguish invalid-input expectation/test defect, finite-step domain-event behavior and actual source applicability. No original gate changed; no unsupported pass claim.
